name: Deep Mars Orbit
story: Above areostationary, in the 20,000-43,000 km elliptical band. The UAE's Hope orbiter is the only spacecraft here — its 55-hour orbit takes a wide elliptical path designed for global atmospheric science: hovering near apoapsis lets it watch entire weather systems develop and decay across the planet's full day-night terminator. Deimos, the outer Martian moon, also orbits within this band at 23,460 km.
comparison: Hope's apoapsis at 43,000 km is about 4% of the way out to the edge of Mars's Hill sphere. The orbit was deliberately chosen to be UNIQUE in the Mars fleet — no other spacecraft sees the planet from this angle.

firsts.label: Hope — first UAE mission to another planet
